summary: Kerb where cars park, but homes 13-19 m away and steep.

best_section.where: West kerb of Clarence Road, between the side street and the apartment blocks

drivers.seclusion: Apartments and houses 13-19 m away on both sides of the road; none closer than 13 m here.
drivers.access_and_room: Parked cars sit along the west kerb in both images, so the lane has parking room.
drivers.traffic: Through road with steady traffic and a junction at the south end.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked along the kerb, so a van would blend in.

flags: Steep: about 11% over the section, 9.5% overall
sun_shade: Mostly open, with some street trees; afternoon sun from the west over the kerb houses.
